title.purpose: Article titles and the reading surface.

body.purpose: IELTS article text and trial sentence.

motion.name: typing-feedback
motion.purpose: Current, correct and incorrect character changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact action for starting or confirming a task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--green, #285c49); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--green, #285c49); color: #fff; font-family: Aptos, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.75,0.25,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1f4c3b; border-color: #1f4c3b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #285c49; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sound Menu Button
components.description: Quiet utility entry showing the active sound pack.
components.css: .ds-sound-menu { display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #cfd6d0; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #18221d; font-family: Aptos, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sound-menu span:first-child { color: #285c49; font-size: 15px; } .ds-sound-menu:hover { border-color: #285c49; } .ds-sound-menu:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #285c49; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Article Row
components.html:
雅思 Task 2

Should University Education Be Free for Everyone?

约 231 词
components.css: .ds-article-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto 72px; align-items: center; gap: 28px; min-height: 108px; padding: 22px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #cfd6d0; font-family: Aptos, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif; } .ds-article-row p { margin: 0 0 6px; color: #69736d; font-size: 11px; } .ds-article-row h3 { margin: 0; color: #18221d; font-family: Charter, Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-article-row span { color: #69736d; font-size: 12px; } .ds-article-row button { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid #285c49; border-radius: 8px; background: #285c49; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Sound Row
components.description: Compact selectable sound pack row with a radio-like marker.
components.css: .ds-sound-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px minmax(0,1fr) auto; min-height: 76px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 8px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #cfd6d0; background: transparent; color: #18221d; text-align: left; font-family: Aptos, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sound-row span:first-child { color: #69736d; } .ds-sound-row span:nth-child(2) { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-sound-row strong { font-size: 16px; } .ds-sound-row small { color: #69736d; font-size: 11px; } .ds-sound-row em { color: #69736d; font-size: 11px; font-style: normal; } .ds-sound-row.ds-selected { border-radius: 8px; background: #e2ece6; outline: 1px solid #285c49; outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-sound-row.ds-selected span:first-child, .ds-sound-row.ds-selected em { color: #285c49; } .ds-sound-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #285c49; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Typing Surface
components.description: The primary reading and typing sheet.
components.html: Whether higher education should be funded by the state.
components.css: .ds-typing-surface { padding: 40px 44px; border: 1px solid #cfd6d0; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #69736d; font-family: Charter, Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.75; } .ds-typing-surface p { margin: 0; } .ds-current { padding: 0 1px; border-radius: 2px; background: #f1d45b; color: #18221d; }

components.name: Back Navigation
components.description: Quiet back control used across practice and sound screens.
components.css: .ds-back { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #69736d; font-family: Aptos, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-back span { color: #285c49; font-size: 17px; } .ds-back:hover { color: #18221d; } .ds-back:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #285c49; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: EssayKeys should feel like a well-prepared writing proof rather than a marketing page. The interface is cool, flat and precise; typography and generous spacing establish hierarchy while rules replace decorative cards. The essay itself is the main object, and the yellow current-character highlight is the single moment of visual emphasis.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper rather than warm cream.
Compact Chinese UI paired with a readable English serif.
One meaningful accent: the current typing position.
The reading and typing task remains visible before any explanation.

rules.name: The One Highlight Rule
rules.body: Yellow belongs to the current character. It is never a general page accent.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use sans for controls and orientation; use serif for content the user reads or types.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Column Rule
rules.body: Content remains left-aligned and orderly. Centering is reserved for the final result.

rules.name: The Rule Before Box Rule
rules.body: Prefer a divider over wrapping content in a new container.

dos: Do keep the current typing position visible and unmistakable.
Do use rules, whitespace and restrained background shifts to organize content.
Do keep controls at least 44px tall on mobile.
Do preserve readable essay line lengths and clear focus states.
donts: Don't reintroduce warm paper grids, decorative circles, gradients or card shadows.
Don't use yellow outside the current-character state.
Don't add all-caps eyebrow labels or repeated marketing copy above headings.
Don't let secondary interface chrome become larger than the article title or typing task.
